scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c yellow,magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @novaplay/shared" "npm run dev -w @novaplay/api" "npm run dev -w @novaplay/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @novaplay/shared && npm run build -w @novaplay/api && npm run build -w @novaplay/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @novaplay/shared && npm run typecheck -w @novaplay/api && npm run typecheck -w @novaplay/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @novaplay/api && npm run test -w @novaplay/web
